patches.title: Persist in Same Container Type
patches.principle: After opening a container and not finding the target, continue opening containers of the same type before switching to another type.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and the current container type has more unopened containers.

patches.title: Fridge First for Food
patches.principle: When the target is a perishable food item, open the fridge before searching cabinets or other containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task involves a food item (e.g., apple, lettuce, egg) and the fridge is present.

patches.title: Avoid Non-Opening Actions During Search
patches.principle: When searching for a target object, only use 'open' on closed containers; do not use 'examine' or 'look' as they waste steps.
patches.when_to_apply: When you are in the middle of searching for an object and encounter closed containers.
